question: Who was the second vice-President of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Zakir Hussain.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The** second vice president **of India was** Dr. Zakir Hussain** (1897-1969) 

 
 
• **Tenure**-**1962-1967**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** first vice president** of India was **Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan** (1888-1975) 

 
 
• **Tenure**- **1952-1962 **
 
 
 
• **Varahagiri Venkatagiri (V V Giri) ** (1884-1980)
 
 
• **Third vice president** of India
 
• **Tenure**- **1967-1969**
 
 
 
• **Gopal Swarup Pathak** (1896-1982)
 
 
• **Fourth vice president** of India
 
• **Tenure**- **1969-1974**
 
 
 
• **B.D. Jatti** (1913-2002)
 
 
• **Fifth vice president **of India
 
• **Tenure**- **1974-1979**
 
 
 
• **Current** (Incumbent) **vice president** of India (as of 2024)
 
 
• Jagdeep Dhankhar
 
• He is** the 14th **vice president of India
